ledger_ref.description: stop calling static drm_fb_helper_alloc_info on Gentoo 6.12

semantics.summary: Gentoo 6.12.111 keeps drm_fb_helper_alloc_info static. The 6.2 branch now returns helper->info when the core already allocated it, otherwise framebuffer_alloc plus fb_alloc_cmap. Failure returns NULL because the caller tests the pointer, not ERR_PTR. The fallback does not set FBINFO_HIDE_SMEM_START or skip_panic.

license.evidence: Local change in the existing vendor Dual MIT/GPLv2 fb helper. No new dependency, binary, or third-party code.

dependencies.summary: Applies to the i6 snapshot after 030-035 and 030-036. Does not use 030-037 through 030-049.

apply.result: One file. Forward and reverse --fuzz=0 both rc=0. Reverse restores the pre-patch file bytes. No .rej.

checks: 030-050 forward --fuzz=0 rc=0 and byte-matches the edited file
030-050 reverse --fuzz=0 rc=0 and restores the pre-patch file

clean_build.summary: Two clean builds of this patch differ only by kernel_autocfg.h define order. cfg_detect.sh appends from parallel jobs. srcversion therefore cannot prove identity with the installed module. The installed ko was left in place.

runtime.summary: No modprobe and no install in this step. The already-loaded module is the earlier hand build.
